name: openrig
description: Build your own network of agents from Claude Code, Codex and Pi: persistent teams with roles, shared context and owned work.
one_liner: A framework for building a persistent 'team' of AI agents, each with its own role and shared memory, instead of one agent trying to do everything alone.
buyer: A startup founder or engineering lead wanting an AI agent team — planner, coder, reviewer — that remembers context across days, not just a single session.
business_use_cases: A startup builds a persistent AI engineering team (planner, coder, QA) that keeps shared context across weeks of a project instead of restarting cold each session.
An agency sells 'managed AI dev teams' to clients, using it to structure accountable roles and hand-offs between agents.
A solo founder runs a virtual product, growth, and support agent team for their SaaS, each with defined ownership.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a hosted multi-agent team platform with pre-built role templates for startups or agencies, as a monthly subscription.

steal_this: This weekend, configure a three-agent team (planner, coder, reviewer) for one real side project and document the workflow as a paid template.
